text: Coinbase's SEC civil enforcement action against Coinbase Inc. and Coinbase Global Inc. was dismissed by joint stipulation on February 27, 2025, following the SEC's formation of a Crypto Task Force.

source.name: US Securities and Exchange Commission, press release 2025-47
source.quote: The Securities and Exchange Commission today announced that the Commission has filed a joint stipulation with Coinbase Inc. and Coinbase Global Inc. to dismiss the ongoing civil enforcement action
